newsitem.title: USA: Walgreen November same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Walgreen November same store sales up.

text.p: Walgreen Co said Tuesday that November same store sales rose 6.8 percent.
Total sales for the month gained 12.2 percent to $1.06 billion from $944.9 million.
Pharmacy sales, which account for about 45 percent of overall sales, increased 15.4 percent. Comparable pharmacy sales rose 9.8 percent.
Calendar year-to-date sales were $10.88 billion, up 13.9 percent from $9.55 billion for the 1995 period.
Fiscal year-to-date for the three months were $3.06 billion, up 13.5 percent from $2.69 billion a year ago.
At November 30, Walgreen operated 2,228 drug stores in 34 states and Puerto Rico, versus 2,110 a year ago.
